newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banamex sets fixed credit card rate.
newsitem.headline: Banamex sets fixed credit card rate.

text.p: In its latest bid to win new clients, Banamex, the banking arm of Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival, said on Tuesday it would offer a 34 percent fixed interest rate for six months on credit cards.

It said the rate would be some 20 basis points lower than many other credit card companies charge in the Mexican market. Fixed rates are uncommon in Mexico, where interest rates have tended to fluctuate wildly.

Mexicans have been reluctant users of credit since their debts sky-rocketed during Mexico's 1994-5 peso crisis, and big banks have launched publicity drives to promote their credit cards. Banamex is Mexico's largest bank.
